scenarios.label: Conflicting versions
scenarios.question: How long may audit logs be retained?

chunks.title: Current retention standard
chunks.excerpt: Audit logs are retained for no more than 400 days unless legal hold applies.

chunks.title: Superseded retention standard
chunks.excerpt: Audit logs may be retained for up to seven years.

chunks.title: Storage runbook
chunks.excerpt: The logging tier uses lifecycle rules to delete expired objects.
